topic.angle: How many zeros on the biggest note

body.question: The largest Zimbabwean banknote was Z$100 trillion. How many zeros does it take to write that number in full?
body.reveal: Z$100,000,000,000,000 is 1 x 10^14, so 14 zeros. In mid-November 2008, a $100 trillion banknote could not pay for a simple bus fare.

probes.question: How many zeros are in 100 trillion (100,000,000,000,000)?
